No. 1989/37 – WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 19, 2016
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT, CHAPTER No. 460
Notice under Section 7

I, hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for a public purpose. Description of the Land to be acquired:

The allotment of in total Extent of about 0.0014 Hectare, shown as Lot No. 132 on the Preliminary Plan No. Gam. 3697 dated of 07.04.2016 prepared by Surveyor General situated in the Village of Ihala Biyanwila, Adikari Paththuwa Minor Division, in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Biyagama, in the District of Gampaha, in Western Province and bounded as follows.

01. Lot No. 132 Name of Land: Jambugahawatta; Description: Road (Siramadana Mawatha); Claimant: State; Original Claimant: K. Malani Katulanda, No. 145/A, Kandy Road, Kadawatha; Extent: 0.0014 Hectare.

All Persons interested in the aforesaid lands on which are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretary’s Office of Biyagama on the 27th October, 2016 at 10.00 a. m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 27th October, 2016 the nature of their interests in the land, the
particulars or their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
W. H. V. PUSHPAMALA, Divisional Secretary, Biyagama. Divisional Secretary’s Office, Biyagama, 17th October, 2016. 11– 165

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT CHAPTER 460
Notice under Section 7
My No.: WGSWD&EIP/ACQ/KB/21.

The General Public is hereby informed that the allotment of land described below, depicted as lot No. 16 in the Preliminary Plan No. Co. 9585 dated 10.03.2016 prepared by the Survey General has not been included in the Notice under Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, published in the Gazette, Extra Ordinary No. 1968/14 dated 25.05.2016 of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka due to an oversight. Accordingly, the said Gazette is amended by addition of the section mentioned below.

Lot No. 16 Name of Land: Bakmeegaha Kumbura; Description: Wewa; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Mr. Daya Gamage, No. 362, Kesbewa Road, Boralesgamuwa; Extent: 0.4161Hectare.

All Persons interested in the aforesaid land/servitude on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Land Acquition Office located in the Head Office of the Sri Lanka Land Reclamation and Development Corporation, No. 03, Sri Jayawardenapura Mawatha, Welikada, Rajagiriya on 30.11.2016 at 10.00 a. m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 23.11.2016, the nature of their interests in the land/lands, the particulars or their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said
land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. All deeds and documents in support of the claims should be produced before me at the inquiry.

C. W. ABEYSURIYA, Acquiring Officer, Weras Ganga Storm Water Drainage & Environment Improvement Project. Divisional Secretary’s Division-Kesbewa. Weras Ganga Storm Water Drainage & Enviroment Improvement Project, No. 03, Sri Jayawardenapura Mawatha, Welikada, Rajagiriya, 19th October, 2016.
